_schema._purpose: Hand-curated record of major claimed structures, for facts that exist only in prose or press material and never as an attribute in any GIS layer - depth, internal diameter, pump capacity, completion year.
_schema._rule: Every numeric claim carries a source URL and the date it was read. If a figure cannot be sourced, it is omitted rather than estimated. Where sources disagree, record both and say so in 'disputed'.

_fields.klima_id: Cloudburst id(s) linking to WFS geometry, if known.
_fields.confidence: high = stated by the owner/utility or the statutory plan; medium = press or secondary; low = inferred.
_fields.claims: Each entry: value, unit, source, read_on, and optionally note/disputed.
